description: EAS NRW DS - Seismologische Stationen in Nordrhein-Westfalen (Erdbebenalarmsystem) - Datensatz is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The dataset includes the locations of the seismological stations, which are monitored by the NRW State Earthquake Service (Geological Service NRW). The dataset is prepared for the INSPIRE topic geology (application scheme geophysics). A network of 15 measuring stations records the earthquake activity of the Lower Rhine Bay and its surroundings. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE - EAS NRW DS - Seismological Stations in North Rhine-Westphalia (Earthquake Alarm System) - Dataset" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Erdbebenalarmsystem, inspireidentifiziert, Erdbebenstation, Landeserdbebendienst, Seismologie, seismologische Station. The listing shows 2024-06-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
